This won't work.
You cannot use the Bang Nahk after burning the Vial of Garou Blood.
You cannot burn the Vial of Elder Vitae after burning the Vial of Garou Blood.
You cannot burn the Blood Tears of Kephran to gain blood
after burning the Vial of Garou Blood.

Yes, you guessed it, you cannot use ANY other equipment
after burning a Vial of Garou Blood. Pesky Card Text.

You can burn both of the Elder Vitae and the Blood Tears before range is
determined though, so you can still use them before the Garou Blood.
You definitely can't use the Bang Nahk with it though.

> pre-range
>
> Weather Control (@ 15 blood, 1 damage to opponent)

Weather Control's damage isn't during the strike resolution,
so cannot be counted towards your total.

> Carrion Crows
> Drawing out the Beast
> Thoughts Betrayed (at inferior, @ 13 blood)
> Imposing Phantasm (+1 str, at 11, costs 1 blood @ 12)
> Torn Signpost (base str 3, at 13)
> Fists of Death (+2 str, at 15, costs 1 blood @ 11)
> Increased Strength (+2 str with a Pot strike, at 17)
> Fire in the Blood (+1 str, at 18, costs 1 blood @10)
> Death of My Conscience (use 4 cards, +8 str, at 26, costs 3 blood @ 7)

> use Vial of Garou Blood (+1 str, at 27)
> use Vial of Elder Vitae to get VIC

swap the order, and burn the Blood Tears first.

> play Inner Essence (+1 blood @ 8)
> Horrid Form (+1 str, at 28, 0 cost from Inner Essence)
> Body Arsenal (+1 str, at 29, costs 2 blood @ 6)
> Mythic Form (+1 str, at 30, costs 3 blood @3
> Blood of Acid (pay with the 2 rush counters)
>
> assume range stays close, or he has enough PRO maneuvers.

Your opponent cannot manuever to long because of the Drawing
out the Beast, so unless they set range to long with Shadow Step,
or Cailean's ability the combat will be at close range.

> strike
>
> Tap the Island of Yiaros (+5 strength to strike). Use Bang Nakh (+1
> from the Mass Reality, doing 36 +1WC) with Pushing the
> Limit (+3 str, costs 1 blood @ 2...doing 41 + 1WC).
>
> Burn Blood Tears (+2 blood @4)
>
> Ghoul Retainer uses the Assault Rifle (for 5 with Mass Reality) and
> Dragon
> Breath Rounds (5+2=7, total 49)

LSJ has already knocked out the Dragon's Breath Rounds.

> Wolf Companion (50)
> Shade (51)
> Murder of Crows (52)
> Thoughts Betrayed (53)
> Carrion Crows (55)
>
> taking 2 damage from opposing minion's strike (1 + 1 from DotB)
>
> prevent
>
> King of the Mountain (SUP does 2 damage, from DotB, costs 2 blood @ 2,
> total
> is 57)
> Blood of Acid (59)
>
> resolution
>
> takes 2 damage, is at 0

Nothing after this can be counted then.

>
> Taste of Vitae
> Twisting the Knife (60 - costs 1 blood, is at x-1 where x is amount of
> blood
> on opposing vampire)
> Pulled Fangs (61)
>
> press phase
>
> Drawing out the Beast 1 unpreventable (62)

This is also not during strike resolution so cannot be included.

> End total: 62, in theory

Minus 2 for Bang Nahk, minus 2 for Dragon's Breath Rounds,
minus 1 for Weather Control, minus 1 for Drawing out the Beast,
minus 1 for Twisting the Knife, minus 1 for Pulled Fangs.
Looks like 54 to me.

> Optional note:
> - If the opposing vampire is Basil, Angus would get +1 strength.

Looks like 55 if that was the case.

Carpe noctem.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The Lasombra wrote:
> > resolution
> >

> Nothing after this can be counted then.

> >
> > Taste of Vitae
> > Twisting the Knife (60 - costs 1 blood, is at x-1 where x is amount of
> > blood
> > on opposing vampire)
> > Pulled Fangs (61)

Twisting the Knife's damage is inflicted during strike resolution. But it would
have to be played before Taste of Vitae (during strike resolution, in fact).

Pulled Fangs is in as well, assuming this large amount of damage is sufficient
to end combat during strike resolution.

Also, the solution involves several environmental sources, while the
original statment of the problem was "What is the most amount of damage
any given vampire can inflict onto another vampire during strike resolution",
implying that environmental damage wouldn't be counted.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>> Also, the solution involves several environmental sources, while the
>> original statment of the problem was "What is the most amount of damage
>> any given vampire can inflict onto another vampire during strike
>resolution",
>> implying that environmental damage wouldn't be counted.
>
>I always believed that environmental damage resolved during Strike
>Resolution. I.E. I INTENDED environmental damage to be allowed.

I think environmental damage (via retainers, etc.) *does* occur during the
Strike Resolution phase. But what LSJ was pointing out was that you said
"damage any given vampire can inflict onto another" and environmental damage
doesn't count in that?

>2) Dragons Breath Rounds. I didn't know about that either. To be
>honest, I didn't see any card text that said no retainers.

Only usable before resolution of a gun's strike. Minion inflicts +2 aggravated
damage each strike with that weapon for the remainder of combat. Burn the gun
after strike resolution. This is an ammo card. No more than one ammo card can
be used on a gun each combat.

(Similar text for other ammo cards). *Minion* inflicts +2 aggravated damage
each strike...(not *retainer* or *user* or *bearer* or whatever).

Halcyan 2
